issues.description: Visibility of the 'rides' attribute in ExcellenceLand is inconsistent: the UML diagram in the problem statement marks 'rides' as public (+rides: List<Ride>), while the task description explicitly states the attribute should be private and the provided solution implements it as private. This contradiction between the UML and the textual instructions/solution can confuse students about the intended visibility and whether they should declare the field public or private.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the specification consistent: either update the UML in the problem statement to show the 'rides' attribute as private (change '+rides: List<Ride>' to '-rides: List<Ride>') so it matches the task text and solution, or change the task text and solution to match the UML (make the field public). Prefer updating the UML to private so it aligns with the explicit task requirement that 'rides' is private.
